observations.seen: Flat, ambient-dominated lighting with no readable key direction. There is no low warm sun. Mountains and track are lit evenly in cool teal and purple, far from the golden-hour recipe.
The drone casts no visible contact or ground shadow, so its legs appear to float above the track. The mountains and the rock overhang show almost no cast shadows.
The drone canopy has a single orange highlight. The track and metal parts show no environment reflections of the bright sky or planet.

The world has a ringed pink planet, an aurora sky, striated low-poly mountains, a rock arch with speckled lights, crystals and floating purple diamonds. The theme is coherent, but the props are sparse and repetitive.
Distance haze softens the far mountains and the start gate. The fog is a uniform teal wash with little depth layering and no light scattering.
The track is a flat purple grid with unlit white crack lines. The mountains use a stretched contour-line texture. The drone materials read as plastic with weak roughness variation.
The drone model is reasonably detailed, with rotors, cameras and canopy. The mountains are simple cone and blob forms, and the gate is a plain rectangular frame.
The drone sits at the right edge, low in frame, and takes up roughly 10–12% of the image. The planet pulls focus upward, and the large empty track foreground dominates the lower half.
The chase view is low and offset, with the subject pushed off-center. The camera does not frame the vehicle on the racing line, and the FOV looks wider than 60°.
The image is low-contrast and washed out, with no visible tone curve, film grade, bloom on the glowing lines, or vignette. There is no cinematic-film treatment.
No HUD is visible: no speed, lap, position or timer readout appears in the frame.
